message: Scope clipping to .rw-select-popover and make labels block boxes; retain natural wrapping in ListBox and CommandPalette. Browser regression probes use real component markup with longer text substituted only for layout. No commit will be created: developer approval owns committing.

R1 layout regression failed before CSS fix (inline label clientWidth=0); R2 ListBox failed before fix (one line). Both now pass; CommandPalette layout passes using visible .rw-option markup rather than an option-role locator. npm run check passes (11 tests, 63 examples, types and build). Final browser suite underway.

Semantic verification complete: R1 scoped block label CSS and 320px overflow test pass; R2 visible ListBox and CommandPalette labels wrap in browser tests; R3 both lockfile versions match 0.2.1, npm run check passes, all 18 browser tests pass. Evidence recorded in VERIFICATION.md. Changes remain uncommitted for developer approval.
